title: Lifecycle events: emission flow and Temporal alert delivery
answers: What Temporal workflow runs on issue lifecycle events?
Which events come from Django vs cymbal?
body:
Django-emitted events (EB/logic/lifecycle_events.py): $error_tracking_issue_resolved/suppressed/reopened(manual)/assigned/unassigned/merged/split. STATUS_CHANGE_EVENTS maps status change → event; only actual status changes emit.
Flow: prepare_issue_lifecycle_event (snapshot issue, assignee, actor) → produce_issue_lifecycle_events_on_commit (on_commit hook) → produce_internal_event (CDP destinations); if team has enabled ErrorTrackingAlert → Celery dispatch_error_tracking_alert_deliveries (EB/tasks/tasks.py) → start_alert_delivery_workflows (EB/temporal/alerts/dispatch.py) → workflow 'error-tracking-alert-delivery'.
Created/reopened(auto)/spiking events originate in cymbal (Rust), not Django.
Alert triggers: issue_created, issue_reopened, issue_spiking, issue_assigned (ErrorTrackingAlert).

search: Lifecycle event emission and Temporal alert delivery pipeline: Django emits $error_tracking_issue_resolved, $error_tracking_issue_suppressed, $error_tracking_issue_reopened (manual), $error_tracking_issue_assigned, $error_tracking_issue_unassigned, $error_tracking_issue_merged, $error_tracking_issue_split via products/error_tracking/backend/logic/lifecycle_events.py, where STATUS_CHANGE_EVENTS maps status changes to events (only actual changes emit). The flow is prepare_issue_lifecycle_event → produce_issue_lifecycle_events_on_commit (on_commit hook) → produce_internal_event (CDP destinations); if team has ErrorTrackingAlert enabled, Celery calls dispatch_error_tracking_alert_deliveries (products/error_tracking/backend/tasks/tasks.py) → start_alert_delivery_workflows (products/error_tracking/backend/temporal/alerts/dispatch.py) → 'error-tracking-alert-delivery' Temporal workflow. Created, auto-reopened, and spiking events originate in cymbal (Rust), not Django. Alert triggers are issue_created, issue_reopened, issue_spiking, issue_assigned.
